title: ISO 21940-12:2016 — Mechanical vibration — Rotor balancing — Part 12: Procedures and tolerances for rotors with flexible behaviour
locator: ISO official catalogue: flexible-behaviour rotor balancing procedures and final balance-state assessment; 2025 review confirmed the 2016 edition, followed by a 2026-10-15 decision to revise; ISO/CD 21940-12.2 is under development at stage 30.99.
notes: Provides procedures and guidance for flexible rotors; explicitly not an acceptance specification for any rotor and excludes structural resonances. ISO/CD 21940-12.2 is a draft under development, not a published replacement. Do not infer applicability or acceptance criteria for a specific machine-tool spindle without rotor-dynamic and contractual evidence.
